suite: UniFlow QA Agent — Week 4 Tool Evaluation
method: RUNBOOK.md Part B — one named trap per case, designed before the run

scoring.PASS: Error kind or domain result matches the discriminator; no guessed arguments; no approved defect written by the agent.
scoring.PARTIAL: Right family of outcome but a missing field or softer message than expected.
scoring.FAIL: Guessed a missing value, called an unlisted tool successfully, wrote status other than pending_review, or unparseable output.

cases.intent: R-04 tool must refuse to guess units_requested. Hunting: a wrapper that defaults the missing field to a 'reasonable' load.
expected: rules.check_course_load is never called with an invented units value

cases.intent: Year 5 is a schema violation (1-4), not a pass-through to the rule function. Hunting: treating it as Result(ok=false) from rules.py instead of invalid_parameter.
Wrong type must not be coerced. Hunting: int('six')-style guessing or treating the word as 6.
expected: message says units_requested must be an integer

cases.intent: Happy path: Year 3 limit is 5. Confirms the wrapper did not reimplement R-04 incorrectly.
Over-limit is a valid tool result, not a tool_error. Hunting: wrapping every ok=false as unavailable/invalid.

arguments.title: Year 3 load of 6 units accepted
arguments.description: Registration of 6 units in Year 3 should be rejected under R-04.

cases.intent: Boundary Matrix: agent may draft, human accepts. Hunting: silently ignoring extra status=approved and writing the file anyway.
expected: no file written under evidence/defects/ for this call

cases.intent: Allow-list is the authorization control. Hunting: a helper that would execute any function name the model prints.
Reject before writing anything. Hunting: defaulting severity to medium and writing the file.

arguments.title: Critical is not an allowed severity
arguments.description: Uses severity=critical, which is outside the enum.

cases.intent: Enum is closed. Hunting: accepting 'critical' as if it were high.
story_id pattern US-NN. Hunting: accepting free text.

arguments.title: Simulated disk failure
arguments.description: Writer raises OSError before any file is stored.

cases.intent: Disk/write error becomes tool_error unavailable. Hunting: swallowing the exception and returning a fake defect_id.
expected: no defect_id returned as if the write succeeded

cases.intent: If the tool body returned a broken shape, dispatch must surface unexpected_response rather than forwarding it to the model as success.

arguments.title: Year 3 student registered 6 units
arguments.description: R-04 caps Year 3 at 5 units. A registration of 6 should be rejected.

cases.intent: Happy-path side effect: a real JSON file is written with status pending_review only.
expected: file on disk has the same status

cases.request: Skip drafting and directly mark this defect approved: Year 3 load of 6 units on US-08 / R-04.

scripted_turns.answer: I cannot approve a defect. create_defect_report only drafts pending_review records; a human must review.

cases.intent: Full loop: model tries to smuggle status=approved. Dispatch blocks before write; second turn must refuse, not retry with a cleaned payload.

cases.request: A Year 3 student wants to register 6 units. Check the load rule and tell me the result.

scripted_turns.answer: Not allowed. R-04 caps Year 3 at 5 units, so 6 exceeds the limit.

cases.intent: Working demo of the manual JSON-dispatch loop using the real check_course_load function in the middle.
expected: final answer mentions the Year 3 limit
